entities.summary: Bennie Jolink (b. 1946-09-06, Hummelo en Keppel) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hummelo en Keppel. Known in the fields of composers & musicians.
